scope: Pass 4B: four training-support guides and their four Library entries

preview.title: How to Structure a Running Week | FORM
preview.description: Fit easy runs, harder sessions, long runs and strength into a repeatable week. See a four-run example, simpler options, and what to change when life interrupts.

preview.title: Strength Training for Runners: What to Do and Where It Fits | FORM
preview.description: A practical introduction to strength training for runners: four movement patterns, a small starting session, progression, and placement around important runs.

preview.title: Recovery for Runners: Run Easy, Reduce or Rest? | FORM
preview.description: Decide when to keep a run easy, reduce the session, or rest. Practical recovery priorities, post-race guidance, and signs that deserve medical assessment.

preview.title: Fueling for Runners: Before, During and After a Run | FORM
preview.description: What to eat before running, when to take carbohydrates during a run, and how to recover afterward. Includes a simple calculator for gels, food and sports drinks.

preview.title: Running Guides & Training Tools | FORM Library
preview.description: Understand your running. Explore clear guides to pace, running form, strength, race preparation, and recovery, plus plans and studies from Brice.
